==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Escort the Oddbodies to the [[Gate of Torment]]
* See Commander Thurnis for your reward.

===Reward===
* 2,500 [[Experience]]
* 200 [[Gold]]

==Walkthrough==
Having survived the preceeding quest, escort [[Captain Yithlis]] and his patrol back to the [[Gate of Torment]].  You will be attacked by 3 [[mob]]s of torment creatures running at your escort on the way, so don't think you can take it easy!

[[Scythe of Chaos|Scythes of Chaos]] like to attack Yithlis and the spell casting party, running around the warriors so keep an eye on them. Consider killing [[Shadow of Fear|Shadows of Fear]] first to ensure that you don't have to face exploding minions in addition to the other demons.

The enemy groups spawn on the route back to the [[Gate of Torment]] even between handing in the previous quest and picking up this one — so if you want to make sure all the Oddbodies survive, you can fight the mobs before you accept this quest. If you killed all enemy groups around the NPCs during [[The Missing Patrol]], they stay safe in that spot while you are off hunting the quest mobs.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Captain Yithlis
:''"They call us '''the Oddbodies'''. Go ahead, laugh. The keepers chuckle when they see us muster. They see us as a group of rejects, but I would pit my squad against anything the Realm of Torment can throw at us! I'm proud to command these misfits. That said, we find ourselves in a difficult position. we have not rested in days, but we have important information for Commander Thurnis."''
:''"'''Escort''' us to the '''Gate of Torment''', otherwise we might not make it in one piece."''
{{offer dialog
|accept = I will help you.
|decline = You're on your own.
|ask = Please lead us to the '''Gate of Torment'''. We can't make it without your help. }}

===Reward dialogue===
;Commander Thurnis
:''"The Captain gave me a very interesting report. He claims Abaddon's forces are summoning a new demonic ally...a powerful being known as the Unseen. It is a terrible creature, the likes of which we have never seen before. It is clear to me, however, that he has no proof and is simply compensating for his past...indescretions...by fabricating a dire plot. In any case, you have my thanks for returning him...and his squad."''

==Notes==
*You can use the Oddbodies to help farm Lightbringer points in this area. It may be worthwhile not to turn in the quest for this reason.
*It is possible to avoid all of the mobs unscathed, with the exception of a few henchman/heroes.
*The quest can be completed with just one member of the Oddbodies surviving.
